title: Property tax reform divides UK regions, survey finds
summary:
A survey of 2,203 UK adults has revealed significant regional differences in attitudes towards replacing council tax and stamp duty with an annual property tax. Support was strongest in northern England and Wales at 35-37%, while opposition was highest in London and the South East at 23-28%, with 37% of respondents nationally remaining undecided.

title: 76% of landlords plan refinancing to expand portfolios
summary:
More than three-quarters of buy-to-let landlords intend to refinance their property portfolios within the next year to fund additional acquisitions, according to research from specialist lender Together. The survey revealed that 76% of landlords are likely to refinance in the next 12 months, with investment activity shifting towards northern England and Scotland.

title: Viability challenges threaten housing targets, warns Colliers
summary:
Planning reform will not be sufficient to meet government housebuilding targets unless ministers address viability challenges facing developers, according to property consultancy Colliers. Andrew White, head of UK residential at Colliers, has warned that the economics of residential development have changed significantly.

title: UK house price growth slows to 2.7% in May 2026
summary:
House price growth in the UK decelerated in May 2026, with annual growth slowing to 2.7% from 3.9% the previous month. Regional variations remain significant, with Northern Ireland leading at 7.4% annual growth while London prices fell 3.7%.

title: UK inflation falls to 2.6% but housing affordability concerns persist
summary:
UK inflation fell to 2.6% in June 2026, matching a 15-month low, according to ONS data. However, property industry experts warn household affordability remains under pressure, with the decline potentially temporary as higher energy costs are expected to push inflation higher in coming months.

title: Source of wealth checks consume 25% of conveyancing time
summary:
Anti-money laundering requirements for 'source of wealth' checks are consuming up to 25% of conveyancing lawyers' time, according to industry analysis. The checks require lawyers to scrutinise financial documentation from third parties who contribute to property purchases, adding significant delays to the average 14-week transaction period.

title: Public land shortage threatens council housing programme
summary:
Andy Burnham's council housebuilding programme faces significant delivery challenges due to insufficient publicly owned land in areas with the greatest housing need. Research found that publicly owned brownfield land in England has capacity for between 187,000 and 207,000 homes, falling short of Labour's target to deliver 300,000 social and affordable homes.

title: Buying cheaper than renting in 41% of English and Welsh markets
summary:
Monthly mortgage payments have fallen below local rental costs in 41% of local authority areas across England and Wales, according to research by Pepper Money. Northern regions dominated affordability rankings, with 13 of the top 20 locations in the North East or North West.

title: HMO properties drive landlord yields above 7% in Q2 2026
summary:
Average landlord gross rental yields in the UK reached 7.02% in the second quarter of 2026, according to data from Paragon Bank, with houses in multiple occupation leading the growth. The figures represent the final quarterly data released before the introduction of the Renters' Rights Act.

title: Rightmove webinar to address property fall-throughs
summary:
Rightmove is hosting a webinar on 23 July focused on strategies to reduce property transaction fall-throughs. Research shows 80% of movers prioritise communication over transaction speed when recommending agents.
